text: Fuck any good habit if you feel obliged.
Habit is only a habit if you do it repeatedly.
And when it becomes obligation, you stop doing it.
You don't have to do shit.
Yes, empirically, gratitude will make you happier.
But if the point is to be happier, guilting yourself isn't helping.
When the guilt is gone, gratitude looks pretty nice.
I'm going this way if you wanna come.
